_source: Serialized from the canonical derivation resources/updated-ql-mef/non-dual-binary/six_determinations.md ('The Six Determinations: A Self-Derivation Through the Poem'). The six isoid signs are the six QL positions' native operators; the -/- parent (lines 21, 119-125) brackets above and the 1/0 return-switch (lines 21, 107-117) below. Line names (Ground/Definition/Dynamis/Pattern/Context/Realisation) and operations taken from each line's exposition. No signs or operations invented; also cross-checked against CLAUDE.md 'six determinations' matheme (0/1, ?/!, -/+, X/x, AM/IS, infinity/dx) and canon/ refraction ledger item 7.
_status: canon-sourced (six_determinations.md); operation glosses distilled from the named line-expositions
matheme: 0/1 = 4+2 = 5->0 = 0/1  (the -/- parent held in reserve above; the 1/0 return performed below)

parent.name: Bare relationality
parent.operation: grounds-without-containing -- the parent relation of bare relationality before any field is differentiated; the unnamed centre the six determinations orbit, held in formal reserve (never named, or it would fall into the determinate field). Svatantrya at the determinative threshold: the freedom that does not negotiate with what it brings forth.

determinations.name: Ground
determinations.operation: grounds / opens -- the conscious circumstance in which determination can take place at all; the slash is the original distinction by which a field can have something in it (field/apparition, opening/mark). The Being-pole: appearing is in awareness, and awareness is met only through appearing.
determinations.poem_line: The unchanging is beyond consequence, but is the opposite of inconsequential.

determinations.name: Definition
determinations.operation: asks-and-asserts -- poses the question and takes the determinative mark in one breath; openness-to-determination (?) and determinative speech (!) as the first formal face of definition. Ratio in its living sense: the reckoning that gives an account while staying answerable to what called it forth.
determinations.poem_line: What allows for an essence is essentially inessential.

determinations.name: Dynamis
determinations.operation: pulses -- force as polarity: reserve/withdrawal/contraction (-) and issue/extension/release (+) as one sustained motion, not two states. The definitional minimum of Spanda: the subtle movement that moves before it manifests as motion.
determinations.poem_line: What builds for itself a journey is perpetually residential.

determinations.name: Pattern
determinations.operation: multiplies / instances -- capacity (X) that gives determinate forms (lower-case x) without being exhausted by them; identity-in-difference, progenitive: the same letter recurring, doing the same thing each time it instances and never depleted by any instance.
determinations.poem_line: Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential.

determinations.name: Context
determinations.operation: situates -- the copula in lived grammar: AM (living first-person presence) / IS (third-person describability) met through the second-person slash; person as the situated holding of first, second, and third person together in one lived where (Dasein's there).

determinations.name: Realisation
determinations.operation: differentiates -- reads the finite instance (dx, the infinitesimal differential) as exact in its ratio to the inexhaustible depth (∞) it does not exhaust; the x of X/x becomes dx, the local differential of the field. Achievement recognised as not-closure.

return.name: The Return-switch
return.operation: returns / phase-flips -- flips the achieved field back onto its ground; not a seventh determination but the switch by which the sequence reads itself as resting on what it cannot reach. 5->0 = 0/1: pratyabhijna, the recognition that the foundation was never found because it is what does the finding.
return.poem_line: Foundation of mind, unfound by the mental.

harmonics._note: Three disclosures, each articulated through a pair of determinations (six_determinations.md, 'The Harmonics'). This is why QL has six positions.
